summary: Require explicit approval before connecting external apps to your Bifrost account.

evidence: Jack authorized the shared CLI/MCP approval repair, compatibility verification, and delivery in the private #381 thread on 2026-11-04.

Independent boundary and candidate reviews traced callback registration, explicit consent, personal approval rights, session binding, impersonation/runtime refusal, and one-time consumption. Candidate objections were reproduced and repaired: access-only credentials cannot bootstrap refresh sessions, and Alembic no longer depends on Redis.

Focused unit, access-list, DTO/CLI contract, API, and browser checks pass. The official MCP Python SDK completes fresh registration and imports an existing Redis client ID while changing a native loopback callback port. Existing CLI browser login and polling remain valid.

The consent display names the acting account and callback; omitted/null/blank app names display Unnamed App. New authorization codes require an explicit decision bound to the request, human session, and live browser refresh cookie. Existing access/refresh contracts and minimum CLI version remain unchanged.

A production-client browser failure exposed cross-worktree replacement of the shared latest frontend image. Browser/client-check image tags now follow the existing per-worktree API tag, and the corrected browser run passes.

Security and any formal release notice retain the separate release review requirement. Actual Claude/Copilot desktop clients were not exercised; the standard protocol and shipped MCP SDK were verified. Public catalog reply and acceptance remain separate.
